scope: Matching API-29/30/31/32/40, RabbitMQ consumer/outbox and workers
environment: Real PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ test containers; Driver/Trip HTTP fakes enforce BA schemas and service tokens

checks.check: Local startup using existing .env, matching_db and local RabbitMQ

verified: All five internal APIs enforce Trip token and validate input
Duplicate events create one job; cancellation before requested and stale versions cannot reopen it
Invalid event JSON/schema goes to DLQ without business writes
Attempt, offer, job transition and outbox are atomic; outbox insertion failure rolls all back
Two accept requests have one winner; identical command replays preserve the stored response
Search tries at most five different drivers; original search deadline never extends
Offer expiry is checked with DB clock after locks; deadline produces SEARCH_TIMEOUT
CLAIMED is retained while Trip is ASSIGNING; authoritative assignment/version controls reconciliation
Cancellation during Driver HTTP invalidates worker lease; HTTP is outside the transaction
Driver outages retry instead of reporting an empty candidate list
Unroutable publishes stay pending; recovery and stale PUBLISHING leases preserve event identity
Consumer retry delays are 1/5/15 seconds then DLQ; retry publish must confirm before ACK
DB and RabbitMQ restarts recover without losing committed state
Application role cannot delete dedup evidence or cancellation tombstones
Identity, Pricing, Driver and health endpoints of all eight apps continue to pass
